stem:
Harsh needs to separate fine atta from larger bran pieces using a kitchen sieve.

Which choice is correct?

options.text: Use a sieve whose holes are between the sizes of the bran and the fine atta so bran stays on top and atta passes through.
Use a sieve with holes larger than both the bran and the atta; both will still separate cleanly.
With holes between their sizes, the fine atta stays on the sieve and the bigger bran falls through.
Sieving will also remove dissolved sugar from sweetened water poured through the same sieve.

teacher.key_rationale: Sieving separates by particle size when holes sit between the sizes. Oversized holes let both through; fine particles pass, coarse stay; dissolved solids are not caught by a sieve.
